title: Direct laser writing of black metals for tuneable plasmonic nanoparticles: experimental and computational insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28526-28534
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00590J, Paper

Taavi Repän, Martin Hruška, Jaroslav Otta, Tereza Hodná, Přemysl Fitl, Michal Novotný, Martin Vrňata, Raivo Jaaniso
A direct laser writing method transforms porous black gold into discrete plasmonic nanoparticles. Adjusting laser power tunes nanoparticle size and shape distributions, and thus the plasmonic resonances.
